function.description: All legal moves in the current position, in SAN.

function.description: Moves played so far, in SAN, in order.

function.description: Stockfish evaluation of the current position from White's point of view: centipawns, or mate-in-N. This is how you answer "who's winning?" — from the result, never from a guess.
function.name: evaluate_position

function.description: Top n candidate moves from Stockfish (MultiPV), best first, with SAN, UCI, and White-POV scores.
function.name: get_best_moves

n.description: How many candidate moves to return.

function.description: Analyze a move: how it compares to Stockfish's best from the same position — centipawn loss, verdict (good/inaccuracy/mistake/blunder), and what was best. This is how you answer "how good was that move?" or "what was my mistake?" — from the result, never from a guess. Defaults to the player's own last move (what 'my mistake' means); pass a color to analyze that side's last move instead.
function.name: analyze_last_move

function.description: Review the whole game so far: every move classified (good/inaccuracy/mistake/blunder) with centipawn loss and the best alternative, plus per-color accuracy scores.
function.name: review_game

function.description: Submit the player's move. Translate what they said into the matching entry in the board state's `legal_moves` list and pass exactly that string (SAN like 'Nf3' or UCI like 'g1f3'). Crisp notation is already resolved before you see it, so what reaches you is looser: "push the queen's bishop pawn one square" → 'c3', "the bishop that eyes f7" → 'Bc4', "queen's knight to d2" → 'Nbd2'. Repair obvious voice slips first ("e 4" → 'e4', "rook to a one" → 'a1'). If nothing in `legal_moves` matches, the move is illegal or you misheard — say so or ask; never invent a string that is not in the list. Call this at most once per player turn: the engine plays its reply inside the same call (the result's engine_move), so never call it again for the engine's side or to answer the reply yourself. If you proposed a move and the player accepts ("yes", "go ahead"), call it now — announcing a move in words is not making it. The engine decides legality: the result says legal or illegal.
function.name: make_move

function.description: Take back the player's last move. Omit plies unless the player asked for a specific number of half-moves.
function.name: undo

plies.description: How many half-moves to take back. Omit for a normal takeback — the app works out the right number itself.

function.description: Reset to the starting position and begin a new game. Pass `player_color` to put the player on that side ("let's play as black"); omitted, they keep the side they have. Call this as soon as the player asks — do not ask them to confirm first. If a game is in progress the result comes back refusing and asking you to confirm; relay that to the player in your own words and stop, do not call again. When it returns ok, the game really did reset.
function.name: new_game

function.description: Resign the game. Defaults to the player's own side; pass a color to resign for that side. Call this as soon as the player concedes — do not ask them to confirm first. If a game is in progress the result comes back refusing and asking you to confirm; relay that to the player and stop, do not call again. When it returns ok, the game really did end.
function.name: resign
